fundraising.module.name: Fundraising
fundraising.module.description: Take gifts of money online, into funds the theatre sets up, run appeals with pages of their own, and keep the record of every gift. Gift Aid and sponsorships follow.
fundraising.navigation.donations.label: Donations
fundraising.navigation.funds.label: Funds
fundraising.settings.giving.presets.labe: Amount buttons on the Give page
fundraising.settings.giving.presets.help: Up to six amounts, in the order they are shown. None is chosen for the donor.
fundraising.settings.giving.min.label: Smallest gift online
fundraising.settings.giving.min.help: A smaller amount is refused on the Give page.
fundraising.settings.giving.max.label: Largest gift online
fundraising.settings.giving.max.help: Above it, the donor is asked to contact the theatre.
fundraising.settings.giving.pay-within.l: Time allowed to pay for a gift
fundraising.settings.giving.pay-within.h: How long the payment stays open before it is given up.
fundraising.settings.retention.donations: Remove a donor's details from a gift after
The amount, fund and date stay for the accounts; the donor's name, email and note are removed.
fundraising.settings.rules.min-below-max: The smallest gift must be less than the largest.
fundraising.settings.rules.presets-withi: Every amount button must lie between the smallest and largest gift.
fundraising.abilities.donation.view.labe: See gifts and who gave them
fundraising.abilities.fund.manage.label: Set up funds and choose the default
fundraising.give.title: Give
fundraising.give.help: Every gift helps us make theatre. Choose an amount, and we will thank you by email.
fundraising.give.no-online: Giving online is not set up here yet. Please contact the theatre to give.
fundraising.give.amount: How much would you like to give?
fundraising.give.amount-range: Choose an amount within the limits shown.
fundraising.give.fund: What would you like it to support?
fundraising.give.email-needed: Give your email address so we can thank you.
fundraising.give.name: Your name
fundraising.give.acknowledge: How we may thank you in public
fundraising.give.acknowledge-help: Such as "The Smith family". Leave it empty to stay anonymous.
fundraising.thanks.title: Thank you
fundraising.thanks.body: Thank you for giving {amount} to our {fund}. We have emailed you a receipt.
fundraising.thanks.asking: Checking that your payment went through…
fundraising.thanks.processing: Your payment is still being processed. We will email you when it has gone through.
fundraising.thanks.not-completed: Your payment did not go through, so nothing was taken.
fundraising.donations.empty-help: Gifts made on the Give page appear here once they are paid.
fundraising.funds.help: Where gifts go. Each fund has its own income account in the ledger.
fundraising.funds.name: Name
fundraising.funds.purpose-help: Shown to donors choosing a fund.
fundraising.funds.purpose-needed: Say what a restricted fund is for.
fundraising.funds.restricted-help: Gifts to it may only be spent on what it is for.
fundraising.funds.restricted-fixed: This fund has received gifts, so this cannot change.
fundraising.funds.offered-help: Listed on the Give page. The default fund is always offered.
fundraising.navigation.campaigns.label: Campaigns
fundraising.settings.campaigns.show-tota: Show raised and target on new campaigns
Each campaign can change this on its own page.
fundraising.settings.campaigns.count-gif: Count Gift Aid toward new campaigns' totals
Gift Aid claimed or claimable on a campaign's gifts is added to what it has raised, once Gift Aid is set up.
fundraising.settings.acknowledgement.ban: Where each band begins. A band runs up to a penny below the next; the last reads "or more". Used by campaigns that show bands.
fundraising.settings.rules.bands-rising: Each band must begin above the one before it.
fundraising.campaigns.empty-help: A campaign is an appeal with a page of its own and, if you like, a target. It stays a draft until you publish it.
fundraising.campaign.title: Title
fundraising.campaign.slug-help: The page will be at /support/{slug}. Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.
fundraising.campaign.summary-help: One or two sentences for the Support page and when the page is shared.
fundraising.campaign.body-help: Why you are raising money and what it will do. Headings, lists, bold, italic and links are allowed.
fundraising.campaign.fund-help: Every gift to the campaign goes to this fund.
fundraising.campaign.fund-fixed: This campaign has received gifts, so its fund cannot change.
fundraising.campaign.production-help: If the campaign is for one show, its gifts count toward that show.
fundraising.campaign.target-help: Leave empty for no target; the page then shows what has been raised without a bar.
fundraising.campaign.offset-help: Money raised for this campaign outside the site, such as a raffle, added to its total.
fundraising.campaign.offset-note: Say where the money raised elsewhere came from.
fundraising.campaign.opens-help: Publishing before this time schedules the campaign to open then.
fundraising.campaign.closes-help: Leave empty to close it by hand.
fundraising.campaign.closes-first: A campaign closes after it opens.
fundraising.campaign.show-total: Show what has been raised, and the target
fundraising.campaign.count-gift-aid: Count Gift Aid toward what has been raised
fundraising.campaign.count-gift-aid-help: Counts once Gift Aid is set up.
fundraising.campaign.list-names: List the names of donors who chose to be named
fundraising.campaign.list-names-help: Newest first, as each donor asked to be thanked.
fundraising.campaign.list-amounts.label: Beside each name
fundraising.campaign.list-amounts.help: Only for a donor who ticked the box allowing it.
fundraising.campaign.shows-names.band: Donors' names, with a band where they allowed it
fundraising.campaign.shows-names.exact: Donors' names, with the amount where they allowed it
fundraising.give.show-amount: Show my amount beside my name
fundraising.give.show-amount-help: Leave this unticked to show your name alone.
fundraising.support.title: Support us
fundraising.support.help: Gifts of any size help us put on shows. Give to an appeal, or to the theatre's work as a whole.
fundraising.support.closed: This appeal has closed. Thank you to everyone who gave.
